# CUDAQSimulationFramework

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A simulation framework built on NVIDIA's CUDA-Q platform that enables scalable quantum circuit simulation across GPU clusters with topology-aware partitioning. Represents a software infrastructure layer that TCC can leverage for topology-aware simulation of quantum-classical hybrid workloads.
